notes: Only the Maguire Peaks minimum and maximum buffer polygons are included. Nest points, other territories, roads, and ownership layers are omitted.
Original KML WGS84 polygon vertices retained without simplification or replacement by circles. Buffer distances interpreted as meters and checked against projected polygon area within 1%.
Minimum and maximum are source layer labels, not newly inferred activity restrictions.
3D fill is rasterized onto the existing 2 m Maguire Ridge terrain mesh; extent outside that terrain cutout is shown only in 2D. Terrain cutout edges are not buffer boundaries.
